mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( post_idx, member_idx, parent_comment_idx, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postIdx}, #{memberIdx}, #{parentCommentIdx}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.nick_name as nickname, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx WHERE c.idx = #{idx}

SELECT c.*, m.nick_name as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx) as likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx) as unlikeCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx AND member_idx = #{memberIdx} ) THEN true ELSE false END as isLiked, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx AND member_idx = #{memberIdx} ) THEN true ELSE false END as isUnliked FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx WHERE c.parent_comment_idx = #{parentCommentIdx} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT c.*, m.nick_name as nickname, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx WHERE c.parent_comment_idx = #{commentIdx} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE parent_comment_idx = #{parentCommentIdx}
